requirements.description: Preserve empty invocation/help/version aliases with no storage/path creation, no configuration validation and no terminal query traffic.
Classify grammar failures as exit 2 before opening storage; preserve argument boundaries, `--`, scalar/repeated flags and explicit patch intent.
Resolve policy/timezone only for valid data invocations; flag overrides environment, then defaults. Reuse storage path precedence and never fall back after an open failure.
Construct a fresh command tree per invocation and inject service factory, streams, terminal facts and confirmation seam; only the composition root owns storage.
Keep Go 1.25, the accepted SQLite graph and five CGO-free targets; pin compatible Cobra/Lipgloss dependencies and embed production timezone data.
requirements.evidence: go.mod; cmd/tusk/app.go; internal/cli/compatibility_test.go; U6 acceptance cross-build receipt

requirements.description: Create tasks through CreateTask with title, notes, priority, date, tags and parent; preserve service defaults and validation.
Patch only supplied edit fields against current data, including explicit clears, moves, status and manual leaf progress; never split a compound patch into separate writes.
Complete a whole subtree through CompleteTask; reopening through UpdateTask preserves service lifecycle, no-op and parent policy semantics.
Require recursion independently from force, preview non-forced deletion, confirm default-No only in an eligible terminal, and pass exact preview back for authoritative recheck.
Implement list OR-within/AND-across filters, default open statuses, all/status exclusion, search, parent/root and half-open local-day due selection.
Render complete forests or selected subtrees, including done nodes, stable sibling order and display depth 1 without changing stored parents.
Expose retained-task statistics and oldest-first metadata history without inventing velocity or event snapshots.
Publish independent, explicit JSON DTOs with stable fields/types/nulls/arrays, exact opaque IDs and full data.
Emit one compact JSON value plus LF on stdout; diagnostics go to stderr. Buffer serialization before output, propagate encoding/short-write failures and never append human text to JSON.
Distinguish syntax, domain/config/runtime, cancellation, unknown transaction outcome, known commit and output/close failure; no automatic mutation replay.
Close an opened owner exactly once on every return path before publishing the result. A close failure discards pending output and retains known commit information.
Human output is readable with explicit status labels, complete IDs, deterministic columns/empty states and terminal-cell-aware clipping.
requirements.evidence: internal/cli/format.go; format_test.go; U6 accepted Kitty evidence

requirements.description: Sanitize untrusted human text and diagnostics against controls/OSC/bidi presentation; JSON preserves valid stored text through encoding. Notes never execute or fetch resources.
Disable color for non-TTY stdout, nonempty NO_COLOR or TERM=dumb; use invocation-owned styling without terminal background probes or global renderer mutation.
Read stdin only for eligible delete confirmation; support LF/CRLF and cancellation, and never prompt in JSON or redirected input/output/error flows.
Prove the real executable's exit/stdout/stderr, storage isolation, committed recovery and concurrent mutation behavior on temporary disk databases.

Measure launch-through-exit p90 below 5 ms for help/version and below 15 ms for queries, with the current tail guards and fixed reference fixtures; preserve every sample and record larger/cold/busy/slow-output observations separately.
